name: Anti-spam, phishing and malware policies
description: Summarises inbound anti-spam, outbound spam, anti-phishing and anti-malware policies with the rule that scopes each, its state, priority, who it applies to and key settings.
prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later installed through your organisation's approved process, and an Exchange or Microsoft Defender role that can read threat policies, such as Security Reader.
limitations: Runtime support follows the ExchangeOnlineManagement module's documented support; not yet tested in a tenant.

A preset security policy (Standard or Strict) is listed as Preset: its preset rule is not read, so who it applies to is not shown. A policy with no rule that Exchange does not mark as custom or preset is Unknown, not NoRule.
Defender for Office 365 policies such as Safe Links and Safe Attachments are not included.
Only key settings are summarised; allowed sender and domain lists are counted, not listed.
A rule is matched to its policy by the policy identity the rule names. A rule naming a policy that was not returned is listed with its settings Unknown.
A true or false value Exchange did not return is shown as Unknown, never as False.
The roles listed follow Microsoft's documentation and have not been confirmed in a tenant.
